generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The logic introduced in this diff checks if any longitude value is exactly 180. However, depending on how the longitude values are generated or rounded, a value very close to 180 might not be caught by this check. Consider using a tolerance range around 180 to handle potential floating-point precision issues.
